title: Week 12
description: Industrial IoT (contd), Case Study: Agriculture, Healthcare, Activity Monitoring

questions.question: Which type of data analysis is used for data that is categorical in nature?
options: Qualitative analysis
Quantitative analysis
Regression analysis
Analysis of variance

questions.question: According to the lecture, when is a statistical model classified as a complete model?
options: When the number of variables equals the number of equations
When the model contains no variables
When the number of variables is always greater than the number of equations
When only categorical data are used

questions.question: Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) is best applied when which of the following are to be compared?
options: Only a single observation
More than two populations or samples
Only non-numerical labels without any response variable
Only identical copies of the same observation

questions.question: What does Pearson's correlation coefficient (r) measure?
options: The number of equations in a statistical model
The maximum value in a dataset
The strength of association between two variables
The sample size of an experiment

questions.question: What is a primary objective of the AgriSens smart water management system?
options: Restricting irrigation control to manual operation only
Increasing irrigation water use regardless of soil condition
Removing all sensors from agricultural fields
Achieving more crop yield with less water

questions.question: Which set correctly represents the three layers of the proposed AgriSens architecture?
options: Physical layer; transport layer; presentation layer
Sensing and actuating layer; processing, storage and service layer; application layer
User layer; billing layer; routing layer
Sensor layer; firewall layer; operating-system layer

questions.question: Which component is included in the integrated design of an AgriSens sensor node?
options: Meter data management system for smart grids
Power management unit
Phasor measurement unit
Hadoop Namenode

questions.question: What is the function of the multi-user server in the AgriSens remote-server design?
options: It supplies electrical power to the sensor nodes
It measures soil moisture directly in the field
It sends field information to the farmer's mobile phone using SMS and executes farmer queries and control messages
It replaces all gateways with wired links

questions.question: In the IoT healthcare architecture discussed in the lecture, which layer contains smartphones and tablets used as data aggregators?
options: Physical power layer
Sensing layer
Cloud platform
Aggregated layer

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of preventive care enabled by IoT healthcare?
options: Fall detection for senior citizens
Disabling emergency alerts
Removing physiological sensors from patients
Storing only paper-based medical records

questions.question: What is an advantage of continuous activity monitoring?
options: It requires all sensor data to be discarded immediately
It prevents any long-term observation
It enables daily observation of human behavior and repetitive activity patterns
It can operate only with cameras

questions.question: Which type of data can be analyzed using the deep-learning-based approach described in the lecture?
options: Sensor data, images, and videos
Images only
Text labels only
Sensor data only and never images or videos

questions.question: Processing activity-monitoring sensor data directly on the device is referred to as which approach?
options: Data-aggregator selection approach
Network-only approach
Cloud replication approach
In-place approach

questions.question: What are the three basic elements used in the smartphone-based activity-monitoring demonstration?
options: A soil-moisture sensor, a pump, and a paddy field
A smart meter, a PMU, and a power plant
A smartphone, a network, and a remote server
A Hadoop Namenode, Datanode, and Job Tracker

questions.question: Which sensor values are specifically logged in the activity-monitoring demonstration described in the lecture?
options: Accelerometer values
Soil-moisture values
Smart-grid voltage phasors
Water-level values
